Boris, you're carrying a lot right now — two time-critical deals plus 13 orphan records that need clearing, and Bluth Company and Kinnamplus are the ones bleeding your attention. Block two hours Tuesday morning to batch-call Bluth and Kinnamplus back-to-back while they're still warm; that $6.5K in must-acts moves faster as one focused push than scattered all week. Lean into your industrial strength — you're running +12pp over the team there, so trust your instincts on those accounts. I'm taking the orphan cleanup off your plate so you can focus on closing. You've got this.

Rocco
